headline: Ansar Allah ballistic-missile strike on al-Alam training camp, Shabwa
dek: (a) Toll at al-Alam camp (Jardan district) now 53 soldiers killed, 200 recruits wounded (was 18-20/50-53 in earlier reports); personnel were new 'Rapid Intervention' recruits lining up in formation. (b) Saudi authorities sent alerts to Riyadh residents Monday warning of 'a hostile aerial threat'.
sources: Shabwa local authority (53 killed / 200 wounded, 'preliminary, could rise'); Saudi Gazette; Al Jazeera (updated story); Reuters (initial 3 ballistic missiles); Ansar Allah military spokesman Yahya Saree (claim of responsibili
fault_line: Operation Yemen Dawn was supposed to end the Ansar Allah in Sanaa — instead Riyadh is sending air-raid alerts to its own citizens. Who's winning this escalation?

sections.what_happened: (a) Toll at al-Alam camp (Jardan district) now 53 soldiers killed, 200 recruits wounded (was 18-20/50-53 in earlier reports); personnel were new 'Rapid Intervention' recruits lining up in formation. (b) Saudi authorities sent alerts to Riyadh residents Monday warning of 'a hostile aerial threat'. (c) Saree: anywhere with Saudi-backed military presence is a legitimate target; strikes will continue. (d) Ansar Allah health ministry: Saudi-led coalition airstrike on Saada killed 9 incl. 5 children and 2 women.
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera (2 stories), Saudi Gazette, Reuters, AFP (initial toll), TOI, Shafaq. Gulf Cooperation Council ministerial council urged arms-embargo enforcement + terrorist designation of Ansar Allah.
sections.what_disputed: Toll reporting moved 18 -> 20 -> 40 -> 50-53 -> 53/200 through the day; local authority says preliminary, could rise. Ansar Allah Saada casualty claims not independently verified. Yemeni govt says forces recaptured Sanamat (Taiz) — unverified claim/counterclaim.
sections.why_matters: Three missiles, 53 dead recruits — the war the world forgot is the front where the US-Iran war keeps reigniting. Ansarallah's message is explicit: every Saudi-backed base is a target. Riyadh's 'Dawn of Yemen' is producing Yemen's bloodiest day in years.
sections.context: Background: Ansar Allah ballistic-missile strike on al-Alam training camp, Shabwa — TOLL UPDATE (extends 1800-01): 53 killed, 200 wounded; Saudi 'hostile aerial threat' alerts in Riyadh — UPDATE

totw_analysis: Our read: Three missiles, 53 dead recruits — the war the world forgot is the front where the US-Iran war keeps reigniting. Ansarallah's message is explicit: every Saudi-backed base is a target. Riyadh's 'Dawn of Yemen' is producing Yemen's bloodiest day in years. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Operation Yemen Dawn was supposed to end the Ansar Allah in Sanaa — instead Riyadh is sending air-raid alerts to its own citizens. Who's winning this escalation?
